name: Banc d'Arguin National Park
description: Banc d'Arguin National Park runs along Mauritania's Atlantic coast between Nouakchott and Nouadhibou, where Saharan dunes meet shallow, food-rich seas. Its mudflats host over two million migrant wading birds each winter, arriving from northern Europe, Siberia and Greenland, while flamingos, pelicans and terns breed on its islands. Local fishermen even work alongside dolphins that drive fish toward their nets.
